text:
Bash is seeking a meticulous and dedicated Manual Tester to join our dynamic quality assurance team. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the highest level of quality and functionality in our software products by performing thorough manual testing. You will be responsible for identifying bugs, verifying fixes, and validating new features to guarantee an exceptional user experience. As a Manual Tester at Bash, you will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements and create detailed test cases that reflect real-world scenarios. Your keen attention to detail and methodical approach will help us deliver reliable and user-friendly software solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced, innovative company where your feedback and insights will directly impact product quality and customer satisfaction. If you are passionate about quality assurance, enjoy problem-solving, and have strong communication skills, Bash invites you to apply and help us maintain our commitment to excellence.

 Responsibilities

• Design and execute comprehensive manual test cases based on product requirements and specifications.

• Identify, document, and track software defects and inconsistencies in a clear and detailed manner.

• Perform regression, functional, usability, and exploratory testing to ensure software stability.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, product managers, and business analysts to clarify requirements and enhance product quality.

• Participate in review sessions and provide feedback on product design and usability.

• Verify bug fixes and enhancements to confirm resolution before product releases.

• Maintain detailed test documentation and generate reports on test results and quality metrics.

• Proven experience as a Manual Tester or Quality Assurance professional.

• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, processes, and best practices.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Ability to write clear, concise, and comprehensive test cases and reports.

• Good communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.

• Familiarity with defect tracking tools and test management software.

• Basic understanding of software development life cycle and Agile methodologies.
